metadata.description: Official plugin marketplace for ShiftOS — the education-first AI operating system program for destination marketing organizations.

plugins.name: shiftos-setup-coach
plugins.description: The ShiftOS Workspace guided setup. Run after installing your workspace: a twelve-step arc that builds all six ME/ identity files, personalizes your workspace contract, and quality-checks the result with one cold test. Session 1 companion; re-run anytime for targeted updates.

plugins.name: my-capture-system
plugins.description: ShiftOS Session 3 homework. A guided interview that produces your Capture Blueprint (visual one-pager) and a Master Prompt addendum. Re-run anytime to update instead of starting over.

plugins.name: role-os-interview
plugins.description: ShiftOS Session 5 homework. The fused expertise-extraction and Role Master Prompt interview: turns what you know about your seat into ME/role-master-prompt.md and ME/unique-abilities.md.

plugins.name: ai-ready-project
plugins.description: ShiftOS Session 6 companion. Run /ai-ready to take one real workflow through the AI-Ready Method's seven moves: produces the project brief (saved as the project's CLAUDE.md), a first draft of the deliverable, and a session debrief. Re-run in the same project to cold-test or tighten the brief.

plugins.name: myos-local-search
plugins.description: Give your MyOS Workspace a local search engine. Run /myos-search to install and configure qmd (a local-first full-text + semantic search CLI), build four collections that mirror the MyOS layers — workspace, meeting transcripts, past session logs, and outside documents — and wire the calibration layer and root contract so every session searches before it says 'I don't know.' Everything stays on the machine. Falls back to Grep when qmd can't be installed.
